title: The Serre-Tate canonical lift is a CM curve over a class field of degree about sqrt(p)
pilot_scope: Frobenius-order class-number sampling and a rational-CM exception
verdict: Frobenius-order class numbers sampled; End(E) not certified. Rational CM gives an exact exception to a universal height bound.
full_protocol_limitations: These are class numbers of Z[pi], not certified End(E) orders. | No general canonical-lift Newton algorithm or endomorphism-ring algorithm executed. | Small-CM rational j is an exception to a universal statement, not evidence about typical random j.

title: Algebraic factor bases over F_p have about p points (dimension obstruction)
pilot_scope: Explicit zero-dimensional factor bases described by repeated squaring
verdict: Small zero-dimensional factor bases have compact repeated-squaring descriptions; cheap decomposition is unproven.
full_protocol_limitations: Demonstrates compact equations for small algebraic bases; it does not demonstrate cheap point decomposition. | Does not contradict a correctly scoped bounded-degree positive-dimensional Hasse-Weil statement.

title: The computable canonical point lift to E(Q_p) carries no DLP information
pilot_scope: Torsion section and lift-independence modulo p^2; original statistic is identically zero
verdict: Torsion-section controls passed modulo p^2; original unrescaled statistic is identically zero.
full_protocol_limitations: No ramified extensions or higher precision tested. | Rescaled uniformity is an exhaustive fixed-point/fixed-curve-lift calculation, not a general mutual-information estimate.

title: Genus-g covers of E over F_p cost p^(2 - 2/g) >= p (worse than rho)
pilot_scope: Genus-two split-cover point-count and isogeny-order control
verdict: Five split-cover Jacobian order identities passed; no index-calculus complexity experiment.
full_protocol_limitations: No Jacobian index calculus or rho comparison executed; no complexity exponent inferred. | Genus-three covers and descent-direction implementation remain unrun.

title: Hidden kernel lattice via elliptic nets, and the elliptic-sieve null test
pilot_scope: Rank-one support falsification of the proposed smoothness/kernel independence test
verdict: Original independence trigger is invalid: nonzero B-smooth W cannot be divisible by p>B.
full_protocol_limitations: Rank-r net recurrence and HNF reconstruction were not implemented. | For every nonzero integral W and B<p, B-smooth(W) implies p does not divide W. This logical exclusion invalidates the original independence trigger; a nonzero MI here is not an exploitable attack signal. | The p-cofactor variant W/p requires prior kernel membership and does not itself find relations.

title: Can a prescribed ordinary E/F_p be a fibre of a high-rank elliptic surface over F_p(t)?
pilot_scope: Eight prescribed-fibre split rational surfaces, plus explicit nonconstant j-image controls
verdict: Eight prescribed-fibre rank-eight split pencils constructed and checked; higher-rank growth remains open.
full_protocol_limitations: Rank eight follows from checked split cubic-pencil geometry; no random-surface zeta-function rank experiment. | No higher-chi rank-growth construction tested; j-image samples are not conditioned on high rank.

title: Smart's attack succeeds on random lifts and fails on the Serre-Tate canonical lift
pilot_scope: Known-answer Smart controls on four anomalous class-number-one CM curves modulo p^2
verdict: Known-answer random-lift Smart controls worked when nondegenerate; four canonical CM controls gave zero.
full_protocol_limitations: No Hilbert class polynomial computation beyond four explicit degree-one polynomials. | Canonical-lift degeneracy was checked modulo p^2 only; no higher-precision implementation.

title: Point-decomposition cost scaling vs factor-base size for size-based factor bases (SAT / Groebner / enumeration)
pilot_scope: Completed two-point decomposition: enumeration versus bit-vector SAT, interval and compositional subgroup bases
verdict: No resolved SAT case beat enumeration; many attempts are censored by the one-second cap.
full_protocol_limitations: SAT uses Z3 bit-vector arithmetic, not CryptoMiniSat/WDSat. | Small m=2 pilot only; no m=3, F4/F5 or completed relation/matrix index-calculus campaign. | No solver exponent fit: range is small and timeout censoring is material. | Factor-base setup and target solving are recorded separately; total cost must include both.

title: Bounded-height section through a prescribed fibre point - the decomposition step of a function-field index calculus
pilot_scope: Fresh-target low-section interpolation search, bounded-MW oracle MITM, and known-answer rho
verdict: Low-section solver has limited fresh coverage; oracle MITM shows no median cold-cost advantage over rho.
full_protocol_limitations: Geometry search covers 92 known height-two section classes only; it is not a general bounded-height section solver. | MITM is oracle-assisted group search; no blind F4/F5/SAT rational-section coefficient-system solver was executed. | Success on planted low sections does not establish fresh-target coverage. | Precomputation, pencil construction and query costs are reported separately; shared precomputation cannot be silently omitted. | MW-coordinate recovery for these explicit classes is exact from the determinant-one Gram matrix; no kernel-relation collection is required because basis specialization logs are known by construction.

title: Lifting a fixed E/F_p to Q - rank and generator heights across the (s, t) lift family
pilot_scope: Fixed-small-curve lift control against a blanket log(p) height inference
verdict: Fixed-curve height control checked; random-lift rank distribution remains untested.
full_protocol_limitations: No rank distribution, conductor matching, 2-descent or full small-point coverage experiment executed. | This selected family is not a random-lift ensemble; it does not refute an empirical average-rank hypothesis.

title: Period-finding on elliptic divisibility sequences mod p has no linear-recurrence shortcut
pilot_scope: Small-field EDS linear-complexity profiles and held-out quadratic recurrence controls
verdict: Five profiles end at L/2; held-out quadratic search finds only the known defining recurrence.
full_protocol_limitations: No universal L/2 profile asserted; value period and zero-apparition rank are distinct. | Search covers quadratic degree and span four, not all degree-three/span-eight systems. | No period-finding acceleration or 40-bit-order sequence experiment demonstrated.

title: Summation polynomials are insensitive to the form of p
pilot_scope: Integer S3/S4 support reduction for three fixed curves and matched prime bit sizes
verdict: Zero support differences in 18 fixed-curve S3/S4 comparisons; throughput not tested.
full_protocol_limitations: No universal Z[a,b] support claim: coefficient specialization/reduction exceptions remain possible. | No full decomposition-throughput ratio or modular-reduction time share measured.

title: Teichmueller lifts are useless for index calculus in F_p^* - size, not canonicity, is what NFS exploits
pilot_scope: Exhaustive Teichmuller representatives at one small prime, with matched uniform-unit samples
verdict: Smooth representatives become sparse at higher precision; omega(1)=1 accounts for the remaining one-event floor.
full_protocol_limitations: No proof of pseudorandomness or asymptotic Dickman behavior. | One-prime finite distribution; sparse counts require uncertainty and more primes before interpreting ratios.

title: Xedni control - dependence probability of fitted lifts
pilot_scope: Two-point fitted rational lifts; exhaustive small-coefficient dependence search
verdict: All nine observed small relations are single-point 2-torsion; no new two-point dependence found.
full_protocol_limitations: Absence of a relation with |c_i|<=2 does not certify independence or rank. | The k=3,4 parametrized fitting families and exact full rank certificates remain unimplemented.

verdict: Small embedding-degree sample is inconclusive; no CADO comparison or sieving.
full_protocol_limitations: Small samples do not establish equality of distributions at cryptographic sizes. | CADO-NFS polynomial selection and Murphy-E comparisons were not run; no sieving was performed. | Curve25519 public-parameter order computation was not attempted.
